versions.changelog:
- Improved reliability by introducing DingTalk proactive push: inquiry results are now automatically sent to your DingTalk after 20 minutes.
- Added detailed environment variable configuration and error handling, ensuring inquiries are only processed with proper API keys and clear instructions for balance issues.
- Enhanced fallback mechanism: results are saved to a file if DingTalk push fails, and delivered the next time you interact with the agent.
- Refined workflow documentation and extraction logic for inquiry information.
- Included thorough lessons-learned section to prevent previous issues and clarify best practices.
